notes: Duskfield, a four-room dark-sky inn on the North York Moors: single-file site (3144 words, 7 sections) with live moon phase, meteor-shower and Bortle calculations, twinkling star canvas (paused when tab hidden / reduced motion), room pricing, accessible FAQ and a validating booking enquiry flow with human error messages, success reference, edit recovery and localStorage draft persistence guarded by try/catch. Four generated photos compressed from ~11MB PNG to ~1.3MB JPG (hero 1920w, others 1280w). Tested in Chromium via a local Node server: page loads with no console errors, one H1, empty submit shows 6 field errors with no data loss, invalid email/non-Friday dates are rejected with specific messages, valid submit (Observatory + observing extra = £463) succeeds with reference and Edit restores fields, drafts restore after reload, FAQ/Bortle/room-sync and keyboard 'B' shortcut work, and no horizontal page overflow was measured in iframes at 1440/768/390px after fixing the brightness table. Screenshot capture was unavailable in this session (browser tool requires a visible desktop window) so visuals were verified by reading the generated images and via DOM/layout metrics rather than screenshots; file:// cold open was not browser-tested, only served over local HTTP, though the site has no external dependencies and uses only relative local assets. Organizer note: resubmitted as version 2 because a v1 run for the same model, category and date already exists; the build itself is unmodified.
